purpose: TASK-008 §4 item 8 — a documented, checked correspondence between the geography strings observed in the PESEL regional resources and official TERYT TERC voivodeship codes. Evidence only. No Place, no table, no connector, no ingestion, and no adoption of the regional resource: D-004 remains open and this file does not advance it.
not_authorised_by_this_file: building a map or any regional claim
presenting registered-domicile geography as origin, ancestry, birthplace or current residence

comparison_method.description: The observed value is compared byte-for-byte with the TERC NAZWA field. No case change, no diacritic folding, no whitespace normalisation and no Unicode normalisation is applied to either side.
comparison_method.why_no_normalisation_was_needed: Both sides were checked and are already NFC, and every observed value is already identical to its TERC name including case and diacritics. A normalisation step would have been unfalsifiable here: it could not change any outcome, so it is not applied and not claimed.

terc_source.voivodeship_row_selector: POW, GMI and RODZ all empty
